Core Benefits

Everything You Need Day One

Sign up for Medical benefits on your 1st day of employment with InSync and be covered the 1st of the month following your start date. We give you options that fit you best. Simple and hassle-free.

Benefit 01

Medical

Sign up for Medical benefits on your first day of employment with InSync and be covered starting the 1st of the month following your start date. Multiple plan options are available to fit your situation.

Spanish Enrollment Guide (PDF) English Enrollment Guide — Coming Soon Questions or ready to enroll? Email HR@insynconline.net
01
Benefit 02

Health Savings Account (HSA)

InSync offers employees a Health Savings Account (HSA) through Lively. An HSA is an individually-owned account used to save and pay for qualified medical expenses, paired with a qualifying high-deductible health plan. For 2026 you can contribute up to $4,400 (individual) or $8,750 (family), plus an extra $1,000 if you’re 55+.

HSA 101 Basics (PDF) Questions? Email HR@insynconline.net
02
Benefit 03

Employer Sponsored Retirement Plan

InSync offers a fully customizable employer-matching retirement plan that allows you to put pre-tax dollars toward your long-term financial goals. Contact a recruiter for plan details.

Additional Perks

More Reasons to Love InSync

InSync professionals enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial wellbeing, and long-term career growth.

Weekly Pay, Direct Deposit

Choose from weekly pay with direct deposit or a pay card. Reliable, on-time pay every time.

Continuing Education Benefits

Continuing your education has a number of benefits for your future, including better employment options and growth opportunities.

Working Advantage Program

InSync employees receive exclusive discounts through Working Advantage on entertainment, travel, hotels, sporting events, shopping, and more.

Identity Theft Protection & Recovery Plans

Identity theft protection and recovery plans are available to InSync employees, keeping your personal information secure and giving you peace of mind.

Top Pay & Travel Reimbursement

The InSync team negotiates the best contracts in the industry, maximizing your pay rate and travel reimbursements so you keep more of what you earn.

24/7 Payroll and HR Access

Access your HR, employment, and payroll information around the clock through our 24/7 self-service portal.
